0022600209.text: The San Antonio Spurs (7-2) visit the Phoenix Suns (2-5) riding a seven-game winning streak, and they are 3-0 on the road, while Phoenix is 0-3 at home... wait, Phoenix is 2-2 at home and 0-3 on the road. Phoenix sits 12th in the West and 4.5 games back in the Pacific's third spot. San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain), and Phoenix is without Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, with the Spurs winning the last meeting 101-100 in San Antonio on March 19, 2026.
